module: World Editor 'Terrain Material Library' window: lists, edits, duplicates, deletes and imports from another level the level's terrain materials (TerrainMaterial), with texture validation (PNG format, power-of-2 sizes, value ranges, distance order), undo through history for properties, bulk texture change and upgrade of the old file format (art/terrains/materials.json to art/terrain/main.materials.json). Depends on editor_terrainEditor (which provides the library and the material proxies). Publishes editor.showTerrainMaterialsEditor(internalName) to open the window on a given material.
notes: A PersistenceManager 'terrainMatEditor_PersistMan' is created when the module loads if it does not exist.
The internal name of a material must not be empty, must not start with a digit and must not already exist (NotificationState_* notification states).
Two material formats are handled: V0 (diffuse/normal/detail/macro map) and V1 (baseColor, normal, roughness, ao, height with texture sizes per slot: baseTexSize, macroTexSize, detailTexSize).

Probable inconsistency in applyMtlChanges: the already-taken name check iterates editor_terrainEditor.getMaterialsInJson() with ipairs, whereas the table is traversed elsewhere with pairs (non-integer keys); the duplicate detection here might never trigger.
The constant terrainMaterialTextureSetPath ('art/terrains/main.materials.json') is declared but does not seem to be used.

dependencies.desc: {"editor_terrainEditor"}: extensions to load before this one.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor render hook: draws the 'Terrain Material Library' window (material list, V0/V1 properties, validation, import/duplicate/delete/upgrade buttons) and the associated modal windows.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: registers the window (710x530), the modals (bulk texture change, upgrade, import) and publishes editor.showTerrainMaterialsEditor.

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated: if the window is visible, reloads the material library (editor_terrainEditor.updateMaterialLibrary) and invalidates the validation cache.
